title: Venue hire stories and ideas
intro: Ideas, updates and stories from events at Toynbee Hall and our historic East London venue.

blocks.heading: A venue with purpose
paragraphs: Every venue booking helps support Toynbee Hall’s charitable work, including free advice, youth programmes and community projects.

blocks.heading: Plan an event
paragraphs: Explore the Lecture Hall, Ashbee Hall and meeting rooms, or contact events@toynbeehall.org.uk to discuss your plans.
